subject: english
title: C：文化與習俗

content.summary: 本課把文化理解放進英文溝通：學生從兩張自編活動卡讀出人物、時間、地點與行動，再以比較句、限定詞和證據標記介紹習俗。重點不是背國家標籤，而是分清楚文字明說的事實、可以提出的有條件推論，以及資料沒有交代的部分。

sections.heading: 學習目標
sections.body: 能從英文公告、資料卡與短文找出 who、when、where、what；能使用 both、while、unlike、because、may 與 the description does not say 比較文化活動；能察覺 everyone、always 等過度概括，改用和證據範圍相稱的英文。

sections.heading: 學習流程
sections.body: 先圈出可直接查證的資訊，再把相同比較面向放入表格，接著用英文完整句表達；若想解釋意義，必須回指原句並使用 may、might 或 seems。最後檢查自己是否把一個社群的資料偷換成整個國家或所有人的事實。

sections.heading: 常見錯誤
sections.body: 看到節慶名稱不等於理解文化；both 只表示某一面相同，不表示兩者完全一樣；different from 後面要指出差在哪裡。資料只寫 visitors 或 some families 時，不能擴大成 everyone；資料沒有交代宗教、國籍或參加比例時，應保留 unknown。

sections.heading: 自我檢核
sections.body: 選一張陌生的英文活動卡，標出三句 fact、一句 supported inference 和一項 unknown；再用 because、while 或 unlike 寫兩句比較。請圈出每句的證據位置，並把沒有來源的 always、all、the whole country 改成精確範圍。

studyHighlights: 文化理解同時需要讀懂英文資訊和控制陳述範圍；先回答 who、when、where、what，再談意義。
以 fact、inference、unknown 三種標記整理資料，避免把個人印象或刻板印象當成文章答案。
比較句必須在同一面向上比較，並用原文證據支持；證據不足時使用 may、might 或 the description does not say。
介紹習俗時尊重社群內部差異，不用一張海報替所有人下結論。

body.heading: 一張活動卡，不能代表整個文化
body.body: Imagine that you are preparing a welcome board for exchange students. Card A says: The River Light Walk starts at 7 p.m. on October 12. Visitors carry small lights beside the river and finish at the old bridge. Card B says: Seed Sharing Day begins at 9 a.m. on March 9. Neighbors bring seeds to the community garden and choose plants for the next season. Before calling either event typical, ask four questions: Who is mentioned? When does it happen? Where is it held? What do people do? Circle only the words that answer them. English helps you locate information; cultural understanding stops you from changing visitors or neighbors into everyone in a country. If the cards do not tell you whether the event is free, religious, or attended by every family, leave that point open.

body.heading: 把資料分成 fact、inference 和 unknown
body.body: A fact is written directly: The walk starts at 7 p.m. A supported inference goes one step further but has a reason: The event may help neighbors meet because the card says people walk together. Use may, might, or seems to show that this is an interpretation. An unknown is information the card does not provide: The description does not say whether every resident joins. These categories also guide sentence choice. Both events involve a community activity states one shared feature. The light walk is held at night, while the seed event starts in the morning gives one precise contrast. Both does not mean completely identical, and different from is incomplete unless you name the feature. Never turn a missing detail into a confident claim with everyone or always.

body.heading: 從兩張自編資料卡組成比較
body.body: Make a table before searching for a famous festival name. For A, record October 12, 7 p.m., the riverside and old bridge, visitors, and carry small lights. For B, record March 9, 9 a.m., the community garden, neighbors, and bring seeds or choose plants. Choose one lens at a time. A supported comparison is: The River Light Walk is an evening event, while Seed Sharing Day begins in the morning. A second is: Both activities invite people to take part in a community event, but the actions are different. If you discuss meaning, write The cards suggest that both activities create a chance for people to meet. Do not write Everyone in the country celebrates with lights or seeds: neither card supports everyone, country, or celebrates. The accurate limit is The cards do not tell us how common these activities are.

body.heading: 證據接力：讓英文句子站得住
body.body: Work in groups of three. The locator points to the exact words on a card. The sentence builder turns them into English. The range checker asks whether the sentence grew larger than the evidence. Fill five boxes—when, where, participants, action, and not stated—then compare only one box. Change Card A from 7 p.m. to 8 a.m. while keeping the riverside; remove evening but do not change the place. Test the inference The event may help neighbors plan together because the card says they choose plants for the next season. If no group can underline the because evidence, label the claim unknown. Exchange cards and ask, Which word supports visitors? Which word limits your claim? This makes reading, vocabulary, agreement, and cultural care visible together.

body.heading: 把陌生習俗寫成尊重差異的導覽
body.body: Create a five-sentence guide for a new original activity card, such as Rainy-Season Street Music Day or Moonlit Coast Clean-Up. Give the card a date, place, participants, two actions, and one unanswered question. Sentence 1 answers when or where; sentence 2 tells who does what; sentence 3 uses because with a detail on the card; sentence 4 compares it with a partner card using Both, while, or Unlike; sentence 5 states a limit: The description does not say whether all families attend. A partner must label every sentence fact, inference, or unknown and underline its evidence. If the card says some participants, do not replace it with everyone. The aim is accurate, useful communication—not making a community sound strange or uniform.

body.heading: 我介紹的是資料，還是自己的成見？
body.body: Revise your guide as if it will be printed beside a school exhibition. Mark direct facts in blue, supported inferences in orange, and unknown points in gray. Ask: Did I copy the date and place? Did I change some people into everyone? Do both and unlike compare the same feature? Does because introduce a source detail rather than a feeling? Did I state what the card cannot tell us? Read this model aloud: Some participants may see the event as a way to meet, but the card does not explain everyone’s opinion. Then write in Chinese and English: 我保留了哪一項直接證據？Which claim did I soften with may? What remains unknown? Learning English in this unit means noticing difference, comparing carefully, and speaking about people without turning one example into a stereotype.

summary: 先以 who、when、where、what 定位活動資料，再決定能否作答。
用 fact、supported inference、unknown 控制英文陳述的確定程度。
以 both、while、unlike、because 和 may 組成有證據的文化比較句。
把方法遷移到陌生活動卡，檢查語法之外也檢查是否尊重社群差異。

exitCheck.prompt: 從一張英文活動卡找出 who、when、where、what，各寫一個直接證據。
exitCheck.expectedEvidence: 能逐項指出卡片英文詞句，不加入卡片沒有提供的國籍、宗教或參加比例。

exitCheck.prompt: 用 both 或 while 寫一句比較兩項活動的英文，並說明比較面向。
exitCheck.expectedEvidence: 句子只比較同一面向，且能回指共同點或差異的資料證據。

exitCheck.prompt: 把含有 everyone 或 always 的過度概括句改寫成有範圍的英文。
exitCheck.expectedEvidence: 能使用 some、may 或 the description does not say，並解釋資料限制。
